stateDescriptions.Default: Two-tab layout (Login / Register). Login: email + password + social login. Register: email + password + confirm + terms.
stateDescriptions.Loading: Submit button shows Loader2 spinner + 'Signing in...' / 'Creating account...'; fields disabled.
stateDescriptions.Empty: N/A — form always present. Render as Default.
stateDescriptions.Error: Invalid credentials inline alert; account locked destructive alert; social denied info alert.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Password complexity checklist (8+ chars, upper, lower, digit, special); email format on blur; confirm password match.

stateDescriptions.Default: MFA prompt text + OTP input (6 digits) + Verify button + Resend/Different method links.
stateDescriptions.Error: Invalid code inline error with remaining attempts; 3 failures → redirect alert.
stateDescriptions.Validation: OTP validates 6 numeric digits; auto-submits on complete.

stateDescriptions.Default: Two options: TOTP (QR + manual key), SMS (phone input). Verification step.
stateDescriptions.Error: Setup failure alert with retry.
stateDescriptions.Validation: SMS phone format; TOTP code validates before enabling.

stateDescriptions.Default: Success: 'Email verified!' + Login button. Pending: 'Check email' + Resend button.
stateDescriptions.Error: Invalid/expired token → 'Verification link expired' + Resend button.

stateDescriptions.Default: Step 1: Email + Send Reset Link. Step 2: New password + confirm + Reset button.
stateDescriptions.Error: Generic 'If account exists, reset link sent' (no enumeration). Token expired message.

stateDescriptions.Default: Welcome header + quick action cards (Book, Intake, Upload) + upcoming appointments list + recent documents + notifications.
stateDescriptions.Loading: Skeleton cards for actions; skeleton list items for appointments/documents.
stateDescriptions.Empty: First-time: illustration + 'Welcome! Book your first appointment' + CTA. No appointments: 'No upcoming' + Book Now.
stateDescriptions.Error: Alert banner 'Unable to load dashboard' + Retry button.

stateDescriptions.Default: Search filters (provider, specialty, date) + results grid with time cards grouped by date. Selected slot highlights.
stateDescriptions.Loading: Skeleton slot cards while searching; selected slot shows lock countdown (MOD-007).
stateDescriptions.Empty: EmptyState: 'No available slots. Try different dates.' + Clear Filters button.
stateDescriptions.Error: Search failure inline alert. Slot conflict (409) → toast + auto-refresh.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Date range (start ≤ end); provider/specialty select validates.

stateDescriptions.Default: Success checkmark + appointment summary card + 'Add to Calendar' / 'View' / 'Book Another' actions.
stateDescriptions.Error: Warning alert: 'Confirmed but PDF failed. Details sent via email.'

stateDescriptions.Default: Full appointment card (provider, date, time, status badge, type) + Cancel (destructive) + Reschedule + calendar sync status.
stateDescriptions.Error: 'Appointment not found. May have been cancelled.' + Back to Dashboard.

stateDescriptions.Default: Current appointment summary (read-only) + available slots grid. Current slot highlighted with 'Current' badge.
stateDescriptions.Empty: EmptyState: 'No available slots. Try different dates.'
stateDescriptions.Error: Slot conflict toast + auto-refresh. Reschedule failure alert + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: Chat interface + extracted data panel (sidebar desktop, sheet mobile). Mode toggle tab (AI active). Input + send button.
stateDescriptions.Loading: Typing indicator (3-dot bounce). 'AI is thinking...' for screen readers.
stateDescriptions.Empty: AI greeting: 'Hi! Let's start with your medical history.' + suggested response chips.
stateDescriptions.Error: AI unavailable → banner + auto-redirect to SCR-010. Parse failure → 'Could you rephrase?' in chat.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Confidence indicators per field (green ≥0.8, amber 0.5–0.8, red <0.5). Low-confidence → 'Please verify' badge.

stateDescriptions.Default: Structured form: Medical History, Symptoms, Medications, Allergies, Reason. Collapsible sections. Mode toggle (Manual active). AI-extracted badges if toggled from SCR-009.
stateDescriptions.Empty: Fresh form with placeholders. Pre-filled from AI if available.
stateDescriptions.Error: Submission failure alert + retry. Server validation mapped to inline field errors.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Required fields highlighted. Date format. Medication format. Real-time inline validation.

stateDescriptions.Default: Dropzone (dashed border, Upload icon, 'Drag files here'). Formats list. 50MB notice. Upload queue with progress bars.
stateDescriptions.Error: Format rejection inline + MOD-006. Size exceeded inline. Malware → destructive alert.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Client-side format whitelist. Client-side size check (<50MB).

stateDescriptions.Default: Table: File name, Format, Upload date, Status (step indicator), Actions (view, delete). Pipeline: Uploading→Scanning→Processing→Completed|Failed.
stateDescriptions.Loading: Skeleton rows. Status badges animate during processing.
stateDescriptions.Empty: EmptyState: 'No documents yet. Upload your clinical records.' + Upload CTA.
stateDescriptions.Error: Failed documents: red badge + 'Processing failed. Staff notified.' + Re-upload.

stateDescriptions.Default: Two provider cards (Google, Microsoft). Connection status, last sync, Connect/Disconnect button. Connected shows sync toggle.
stateDescriptions.Empty: Both cards 'Not connected' with Connect buttons.
stateDescriptions.Error: OAuth denied → info toast. Token refresh failure → 'Re-authorization needed' + Reconnect.

stateDescriptions.Default: Insurance provider autocomplete + Insurance ID input + Validate button. Result area hidden. Skip link.
stateDescriptions.Error: Service unavailable → warning 'Insurance check unavailable. Proceed without.'
stateDescriptions.Validation: Not found → amber alert (soft check). Found → green alert with details.

stateDescriptions.Default: Profile info (name, email, phone, DOB) editable. Password change. Notification toggles (email/SMS). Data deletion link. Active sessions.
stateDescriptions.Error: Save failure toast.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Email format. Phone format. Password complexity.

stateDescriptions.Default: Paginated table: Date, Provider, Specialty, Status badges, Actions (View). Filter bar: status, date range. Sort by date.
stateDescriptions.Empty: EmptyState: 'No appointment history yet. Book your first.' + CTA.
stateDescriptions.Error: Fetch failure alert + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: Summary cards (Appointments, Walk-ins, Arrived, Pending). Queue preview (next 5). Alerts panel. Quick actions: Walk-in, Queue, Lookup.
stateDescriptions.Error: Alert banner + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: Nav cards (Users, Audit, Metrics). Overview: total users, today's activity, system health.
stateDescriptions.Empty: New deployment: 'System initialized. Add your first staff user.' + CTA.
stateDescriptions.Error: Alert banner + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: Real-time queue: position, patient, time, provider, status (Scheduled/Walk-in/Arrived), risk tier badge, actions (Mark Arrived, View). Drag handles. Summary bar.
stateDescriptions.Error: Fetch failure alert. Already arrived → warning toast.

stateDescriptions.Default: Patient search bar. Results list. 'Create New Patient' button. Slot selection or 'Add to Queue'. Booking summary.
stateDescriptions.Empty: 'Search for an existing patient or create a new record.'
stateDescriptions.Error: Creation failure alert. No slots → 'Add to queue with estimated wait time.'
stateDescriptions.Validation: Search min 2 chars. New patient required fields (name, phone or email).

stateDescriptions.Default: Patient header (name, DOB, insurance). Tabs: Vitals, Medications, Allergies, Diagnoses, Procedures. Conflict indicators. Source refs. Confidence badges.
stateDescriptions.Empty: 'No clinical data available. Patient needs to upload documents.'
stateDescriptions.Error: Aggregation failure alert + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: Conflict list. Each card: field, Value 1 (Source A), Value 2 (Source B), actions (Select 1/2, Custom, Clinical Review). Resolution history.
stateDescriptions.Empty: Success: 'No data conflicts detected. All data is consistent.'
stateDescriptions.Error: Resolution save failure toast + retry.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Custom value validates against field type constraints.

stateDescriptions.Default: Patient summary. Suggested codes table: Code, Description, Confidence badge, Source ref, Actions (Accept/Modify/Reject). Manual entry section. Summary.
stateDescriptions.Empty: 'No medical codes could be mapped from available data.'
stateDescriptions.Error: 'Code mapping service unavailable. Manual entry available.'

stateDescriptions.Default: Calendar (day/week toggle) showing appointments by provider/time. Blocks: patient, time, status, risk tier badge. Color legend.
stateDescriptions.Error: Fetch failure alert + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: DataTable: Name, Email, Role badge, Status, Last Login, Actions (Edit, Deactivate). Search. Role filter. 'Create User' button. Pagination.
stateDescriptions.Empty: 'No additional users created yet.' + Create User CTA.
stateDescriptions.Error: Create/update failure toast. Last admin deactivation → destructive alert.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Email uniqueness on create. Role required.

stateDescriptions.Default: DataTable (read-only): Timestamp, Actor (name + role badge), Action, Resource, Details (expandable). Filters: date, actor, action, resource. Export (CSV/JSON). Pagination.
stateDescriptions.Empty: 'No audit entries found for applied filters.' with filter summary.
stateDescriptions.Error: Query failure alert + retry.
stateDescriptions.Validation: Date range start ≤ end. Immutable — no edit/delete controls.

stateDescriptions.Default: Summary cards: Patients, Appointments, No-Show Rate, AI Agreement. Trend charts (line/bar). Date range filter.
stateDescriptions.Empty: 'No data yet. Metrics will appear as platform is used.'
stateDescriptions.Error: Individual chart error states with retry per chart.

stateDescriptions.Default: 'Your session will expire in 2 minutes.' + countdown timer + Extend Session (primary) + Log Out (secondary).
stateDescriptions.Error: N/A — render as Default.

stateDescriptions.Default: Appointment summary + Confirm Booking (primary) + Cancel (secondary).
stateDescriptions.Error: Booking failure alert inside dialog + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: 'Are you sure you want to cancel?' + Keep Appointment (secondary) + Yes, Cancel (destructive).
stateDescriptions.Error: Cancellation failure alert + retry.

stateDescriptions.Default: Form: Name, Email, Role select + Create/Save (primary) + Cancel. Edit pre-fills.
stateDescriptions.Error: Save failure alert inside dialog.

stateDescriptions.Default: Field name, Value 1 + Source A document, Value 2 + Source B document. Actions: Accept Value 1/2, Enter Custom, Mark for Review.
stateDescriptions.Error: Resolution save failure.

stateDescriptions.Default: Rejection reason (format/size/malware) + accepted formats list (.pdf, .docx, .jpg, .png, .dicom, .fhir) + max size (50MB) + OK button.
stateDescriptions.Error: N/A.

stateDescriptions.Default: 30s countdown ring + 'Proceed to Confirm' (primary) + 'Release Slot' (secondary).
stateDescriptions.Error: Lock expired → 'Slot released. Select another.' + auto-dismiss.

rules: All colors MUST reference semantic tokens — no raw hex in component styles
All typography MUST use defined style tokens (h1–h4, body, body-sm, label, caption, code)
All border-radius MUST use radius tokens (sm, DEFAULT, md, lg, xl, 2xl, full)
All shadows MUST use shadow scale tokens (sm, DEFAULT, md, lg)
All z-index values MUST use z-index tokens (sticky:40, dropdown:50, overlay:60, modal:70, popover:80, toast:90, tooltip:100)

principles: Use only Shadcn UI primitives — custom components (ChatBubble, StepIndicator, EmptyState, OTPInput, FileUpload, BottomNav, Timeline, QRCode) MUST compose from Shadcn primitives
All interactive components MUST have 6 states: Default, Hover, Focus, Active, Disabled, Loading
All form inputs MUST have: label, placeholder, error, and disabled states
All buttons MUST have loading state with Loader2 spinner
Button loading state: icon=Loader2 (spinning), text=contextual ('Signing in...', 'Saving...'), disabled=true

Sidebar collapsed (64px icons); tables remain; dialogs centered; page padding 24px

Sidebar expanded; max-width 1280px content area; centered layout

cases.solution: Truncate with ellipsis + full name in tooltip
Persistent top banner (WifiOff icon); local state preserved; retry on reconnect
Virtualized list with search filter; summary bar visible
MOD-001 warns; local draft preserved; post-login returns to intake

requirements.implementation: Semantic HTML (headings, lists, tables, form labels)
All color-coded indicators include icon + text label
3:1 for UI components and graphical objects
Full keyboard navigation for all interactive elements
No focus traps; Escape closes modals
Logical tab order following DOM order
2px primary ring on all interactive elements
ARIA labels on all complex widgets
